# M5.3 recorded decisions (human-reviewed)

**Status:** Binding for M5.3. **Implementation Done** (proof route + OrganizationContext). Do not treat the architecture audit as executable.

**ADR-015** is **Accepted** in [`docs/architecture-baseline.md`](architecture-baseline.md) §20 ([ADR-015](architecture-baseline.md#adr-015--m53-request-scoped-organization-context)). Do not edit ADR-002, ADR-005, ADR-013, or ADR-014 Decision rows.

## Adopted answers

| # | Decision | Answer |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | Proof HTTP surface | **`GET /api/v1/organizations/:organizationId/context`** is the **sole** new M5.3 production-meaningful proof route. |
| 2 | Authorization denial | **`ORG_FORBIDDEN` → HTTP 403**, one generic body. Do **not** distinguish unknown organization, organization without membership, another tenant, or zero memberships. |
| 3 | ADR | Additive **ADR-015 Accepted** before any M5.3 implementation. |
| 4 | Organization selection | Path parameter **`:organizationId`** on that single proof resource. Client `organizationId` is a **request**, never authorization authority. |

## Preserved (not reopened)

- Session authenticates **User only** (ADR-014).
- **Memberships** authorize the requested organization.
- **No** `sessions.organization_id`.
- **No** `currentOrganizationId` (or equivalent) on AuthContext.
- **No** schema change or migration.
- **No** M4 Goal/Path/Step/Evidence ownership columns.
- **No** Learner.
- **No** RBAC gate (membership existence only; role may appear on 200 payload).
- **Confirm/generate remain public.**
- **Golden Reference unchanged.**
- **M6** owns learning-object tenant ownership and later broader tenant-aware operations.

## Out of M5.3

Schema/migrations, `sessions.organization_id`, M4 ownership, Learner, full RBAC, global `X-Organization-Id` middleware, switch-organization endpoint, membership CRUD HTTP, protecting confirm/generate, Golden Reference login/dual-write, login/logout/cookie/rate-limit changes, Redis, JWT as primary auth.
